text:
alex: FYI main CI turned red right after merge of D4567 — the smoke-endpoint job is failing consistently on the same integration test 
ci-bot: Build 98234 failed: smoke-endpoint (timeout) — https://ci.example.com/build/98234 :warning:
priya: confirming, I just tried a manual rerun and it failed again within ~45s, same stack trace
jason: can we get the failing test name? I see a timeout in the logs but need the exact assertion to triage
priya: failing line: AssertionError: expected response.status == 200 (got 504) -- service timed out waiting for model backend
maya_oncall: tagging @jason since he touched endpoint routing in D4567, can you take a quick look? :eyes:
jason: on it, pulling the logs now. If it's the routing change we can rollback, but let's bisect first — what was last green commit?
priya: last green on main before merge was 230ff9a, merge commit is d3a4b21 (D4567).
priya: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T18:12:03Z ERROR request_handler: downstream call timed out after 30s
2026-03-17T18:12:03Z INFO retrying request (attempt 2)
2026-03-17T18:12:48Z ERROR request_handler: final attempt failed, returning 504
```
alex: short term options: 1) rerun a few times to rule out transient, 2) bisect to confirm D4567, 3) revert D4567 if owner can't hotfix quickly
ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex — queued build 98235
priya: 98235 also failed, identical 504 within 30s — not flake
jason: ok narrowing: my change touched max-concurrent-backends config. If the merge applied a lower default it could starve the model clients. I'm going to check rollout config in the PR
maya_oncall: FYI alerting shows a small spike in connection errors to model-pool around the same time — might correlate
sre-bot: Noted. Increasing temporary concurrency cap on staging to 64 for diagnostic testing (not prod).
jason: quick test locally with a bump in concurrency fixed the timeout. I can prepare a revert PR or follow-up that restores prior default while we figure perf implications
alex: prefer follow-up + hotfix unless we think revert is safer. Who can push the hotfix right now?
priya: I can open the hotfix PR (D4579) to restore previous default and request an expedited review.
maya_oncall: I'll approve and merge once CI passes smoke locally. If it doesn't, we'll revert.
jason: thanks — also adding an automated canary to prevent future merges that lower the concurrency threshold without perf sign-off
alex: great. @priya, open the PR and paste link here. If anyone sees other failing routes, call it out.
priya: D4579 opened: https://phabricator.example.com/D4579 — small change to default concurrency, running CI now.
ci-bot: Build 98250 queued for D4579
ci-bot: Build 98250 passed smoke-endpoint. Pending full pipeline. :white_check_mark:
alex: merging D4579 once full pipeline green. thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
maya_oncall: marking this incident as mitigated, will add postmortem note if follow-up needed.
